Title: Azure Cognitive Services—Speech Service now generally available

Body.Content:
Speech service is now generally available.

 

Speech service combines the following capabilities in one service: speech-to-text; text-to-speech; custom speech; and speech translation. General availability pricing for the speech service will go into effect on November 1, 2018.

 

Download the price sheet.

 

Learn more on Azure updates.
